description: Reviewed pedagogical forms that share a lexical entry. Legacy word IDs and taught forms remain unchanged. These are explicit aliases, not a general deconjugation heuristic.

agemasu.reason: Polite nonpast of the authored あげる give sense; retains its local identity while upstream spelling remains ambiguous.

aimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 会う (meet).

asobimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 遊ぶ (play).

arimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of the inanimate existence verb ある.

hairimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 入る (enter).

imasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of the animate existence verb いる.

ikimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 行く.

kaerimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 帰る (return home), not another かえる verb.

kimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 来る (come), not 着る (wear).

kikimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 聞く (listen).

mimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 見る (see/watch).

nemasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 寝る (sleep/go to bed).

niaimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 似合う (suit/look good on).

nomimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 飲む.

norimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 乗る (ride/get on).

okimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 起きる (get up), not 置く (put).

orimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 降りる (get off), not humble existence おる.

sumimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 住む (live), not 済む (finish).

tabemasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 食べる.

tomarimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 泊まる (stay overnight), not 止まる (stop).

torimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 撮る (take a photograph), not an unrelated とる verb.

tsukaremasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 疲れる (get tired).

tsukimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 着く (arrive), not another つく verb.

utaimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 歌う (sing).

yasumimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of 休む (rest/be absent).

shimasu.reason: Polite nonpast form of する.
